design: One pack for both datasets. Grouped by dataset template (not one queryset per scale). TDrive: tdrive_template_v2 shares x1/x10/x50; x100 dedicated. Porto: porto_template_v2 shares s10/s25/s50/s100. Per-scale blocks are instantiations (manifest/oracle/reference_tid); query_ids collide across scales so answers stay nested.

tdrive.x100_exception: x100 BoundIRs are dedicated; do not share with x1/x10/x50.
